# Principles

## Purpose

Fixture: BR rules quoted with their own ID and their exact SPEC.md §2.1 text (REQ-006 AC2). BR-17 is mentioned by ID only.

> **BR-05:** The brand is premium, fun, and energetic. It is **never childish or generic.**

> **BR-06:** The UI is high-contrast, vibrant, and legible.

## Usage rules

### When to use

Quotes compare as plain text, so emphasis may differ:

> **BR-05:** The brand is premium, fun, and energetic. It is never childish or generic.

### When not to use

Fenced code is not prose, so it is not checked:

```text
BR-99 The UI is high-contrast, vibrant, and legible.
```
